_comment: Tier-1 mcp_tool source presets for atlassian-agent (AU-KG.ingest.mcp-tool-connector). Syncs Confluence pages (documents) and Jira issues into the KG via the atlassian-agent MCP server. Contributed presets win over the central MCP_TOOL_PRESETS. Native typed-node ingestion is also available via the atlassian_ingest_issues / atlassian_ingest_confluence tools.
